# Notation {.unnumbered}

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $Z$ | Full observed random vector for one independent unit |
| $Z_1,\ldots,Z_n$ | Independent and identically distributed observations |
| $\beta$ | Finite-dimensional parameter of interest |
| $\eta$ | Nuisance parameter, often infinite-dimensional |
| $S_\beta$ | Score for $\beta$ |
| $\Lambda$ | Tangent space |
| $\Lambda^\perp$ | Orthogonal complement of a tangent space |
| $\varphi$ | Influence function |
| $\varphi^{\mathrm{eff}}$ | Efficient influence function |
| $R$ | Indicator that the full data are observed |
| $\pi$ | Observation or response probability |

Add chapter-specific notation to this table as the manuscript develops.
